sloka: ते सरांसि सरित् कक्षान् आकाशम् नगराणि च ।नदी दुर्गान् तथा शैलान् विचिन्वन्ति समन्ततः ॥४-४७-२॥
transliteration: te sarāṁsi sarit kakṣān ākāśam nagarāṇi ca ।nadī durgān tathā śailān vicinvanti samantataḥ ॥4-47-2॥

translations.english: They went looking everywhere in the tanks, in the bottom of rivers, in towns, in the sky and similarly in inaccessible rivers, mountains, and forts surrounded by rivers.
